title: Pocket-Size Pill Box – 7 Compartments with Airtight Lid
descriptionHtml:
The pills travel in a rattling jar

The weekend bag gets packed and the medicine comes along in its original box that takes up space, or loose in a jar where everything gets mixed.

The box that takes the week's doses in your jacket pocket

Seven separate compartments under an airtight lid, 9 × 7 × 3.5 cm – the box disappears into a jacket pocket or toiletry bag. The compartments keep the days apart, the lid keeps the tablets dry.

Features

  • The week's doses in your jacket pocket – 9 × 7 cm, smaller than a deck of cards
  • Seven compartments keep the days apart – nothing loose to get mixed
  • The lid closes tightly – the tablets stay dry in the bag
  • Opens with one hand – the latch releases with your thumb

Change of mind

You have 14 days to change your mind, counted from the day you receive the item.
